clauses.title: CL-D110 records review-only accounting across fresh runs
clauses.section: ## CL-D110 — Review-only carries earlier rounds and stops after five without MERGE_READY
requires: a `BLOCKED` round is not, since it ended on a failure rather than a verdict to act on
At five counted rounds a run stops `WAITING_FOR_OWNER` before any validation or gate and names the count.
Changing N, reading a round from an untrusted author or a bot, or carrying a proposal or a needs-owner-decision line requires a new owner decision.
A line still marked `(proposed …)`, a deferral included, is an open proposal

clauses.title: The review-only driver reads earlier rounds and stops at five
review-only.md names the cross-run bound
requires: - The packaged review-only driver, across fresh runs of one pull request (CL-D110): its earlier rounds are the trusted conversation comments that open `# Review state:` with a `tidd-status` block for the target. Their settled findings, those marked recorded or confirmed, reach every gate as settled; a proposal, a deferral included, is not carried. After five such rounds without `MERGE_READY`, a BLOCKED one not counted, a run stops `WAITING_FOR_OWNER` before any gate, until a `MERGE_READY` round or a trusted comment opening with the line `tidd-budget: continue` restarts the count.

clauses.title: CL-D11 and CL-D93 name the cross-run bound
CL-D12 and the shared contract name the cross-run bound
requires: CL-D110 later bounded the packaged review-only driver across runs, reading the pull request's earlier rounds rather than a state file

clauses.title: The ledger and the stop are pinned
requires: Issue #259 the settled findings of earlier rounds reach every gate, with the head they were raised on
Issue #259 a round that names no head carries its findings without one
Issue #259 a round by an untrusted author or a bot, or for another target, is not read
Issue #259 five earlier rounds without MERGE_READY stop the run before any gate
Issue #259 untrusted, bot and BLOCKED publications do not count toward the stop
Issue #259 a MERGE_READY round or a trusted continue comment starts the count again
